text:
Jia (Product): Quick sync — we need final gating for the Private staging runbook today. Customer wants staging by EOD next week. Who owns KMS/HSM gating, prewarm, and quota? @Matt @Viv

Matt (Eng Runtime): I can own runtime prewarm + KV cache sanity checks. KMS signoff needs security from @Sasha. Prewarm runbook draft: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/prewarm (WIP).

Viv (Infra PM): Infra will handle capacity pinning and staging cluster provisioning. We need committed GPU quota from cloud before scheduling. @Omar can you confirm quota lead time and if we can expedite?

Omar (SRE): Quota requests are typically 72h. We can escalate to 24h if we file a P1 with cloud and oncall approves. Also want a canary rollback policy for the autoscaler — otherwise risk noisy neighbor effects.

Sasha (Security): KMS/HSM: I need key-rotation checklist, scoped IAM perms, and audit logs enabled before approving customer-managed keys in staging. If control-plane audit + scoped perms are in place, I can sign off. Also recommend a pen-test on staging (3 days).

Matt (Eng Runtime): For canary routing, plan is to fallback to a hosted, smaller quantized model variant if private model fails. Need Product to confirm acceptable fallback quality and traffic % for canary. Fallback must be opt-in for the customer.

Jia (Product): Accept fallback to hosted-mini for up to 10% traffic during canary, opt-in only. SLA gating: target p95 latency < 200ms for 90% of requests; if p95 > 220ms trigger rollback. That should be our launch cutoff.

Omar (SRE): Got it. We'll add per-route p95, token-level breakdown, and an alert at 220ms. Who will own the dashboard?

Viv (Infra PM): Infra can provide a dashboard template + provisioning playbook. Product needs to send full route list and traffic profiles. @Jia please share those by EOD.

Sasha (Security): Scheduling note: pen test + KMS checklist needs to finish before onboarding. Can slot pen test next week if we freeze the runbook today.

Matt (Eng Runtime): Action items from runtime side: create runbook PR with prewarm steps, KV sanity checks, and graceful-fallback config. ETA: tomorrow 12:00. Will link PR here when ready.

Jia (Product): Summary of owners: runtime prewarm/runbook — Matt; infra quota/provisioning/dashboard — Viv; SRE escalation/alerts — Omar; security/KMS + pen test — Sasha. Action checklist follows.

```
- [ ] Jia: share route list + traffic profiles (by EOD)
- [ ] Matt: PR runbook + canary/fallback config (tomorrow 12:00)
- [ ] Viv: request GPU quota (today, 72h) + dashboard template
- [ ] Omar: implement p95 alert, ready to escalate quota if needed
- [ ] Sasha: KMS checklist + schedule pen test (3d)
```

deploybot: created ticket #RDW-4821 (private-staging-gating) and linked to this thread.

Jia (Product): Thanks all — if no blockers, we'll freeze the runbook and start quota request today. :thumbsup:

Matt (Eng Runtime): :thumbsup: I’ll post the PR link shortly.

Viv (Infra PM): Starting quota request now.

Sasha (Security): Scheduling pen test pending route list.

Omar (SRE): Oncall notified for potential quota escalation.
